For any graph with n vertices, average degree d, and girth g = 2r+1, we must have:
$$n \geq 1 + d + d(d-1) + d(d-1)^2 + \cdots + d(d-1)^{r-1}$$

$$n \geq 1 + d + d(d-1) + d(d-1)^2$$

Average degree d = 2m/n = 38/14 ≈ 2.714

$$n_0 = 1 + 2.714 + 2.714(1.714) + 2.714(1.714)^2$$
$$= 1 + 2.714 + 4.652 + 7.975 \approx 16.34$$

Since 14 < 16.34, the bound is violated.
